g.aria-label: Native pin functions; alternatives share pins. Overbar = inverted/active low.
PB5*: RESET by default; GPIO/PCINT5 require RSTDISBL configuration.
USI: DI/DO/USCK for 3-wire, SDA/SCL for 2-wire; firmware required.
MOSI/MISO/SCK are ISP aliases; USI-master MOSI uses DO, MISO uses DI.
No hardware DAC or UART. PWM filtering and software/USI UART are options.
